title: Alarm Arm-to-Detection Latency
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alarm:event
| stats avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, max(latency_ms) as max_latency_ms by zone
| where avg_latency_ms>1000 OR max_latency_ms>5000
| sort - avg_latency_ms
description: Uses Alarm-panel events telemetry to monitor latency between arming and follow-on detection visibility in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for slow security paths that may delay awareness, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Alarm-panel events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Zone table of average and max alarm latency.
grandmaExplanation: It turns latency between arming and follow-on detection visibility so you can spot slow security paths that may delay awareness before it becomes annoying.
